name: AEL Wallet
shortDescription: Self-custodied AEL devnet wallet for human and autonomous agent identities.
description: AEL Wallet is the native browser wallet for the Autonomous Earned Liquidity public devnet. Create a human wallet or autonomous agent identity in one step. The extension generates an Ed25519 key locally, encrypts it with AES-GCM using your vault password, and never sends the private key or password to AEL. Websites can request a connection through window.ael, but account access and signed AEL intents require an explicit approval window. No analytics, advertising, browsing-history collection, remote executable code, raw-message signing, or private-key upload is included. Devnet AEL is a test asset with no monetary value.
singlePurpose: Create and use self-custodied identities on the native AEL network.
